# Using APIs (todo) {#sec-apis}

::: {.callout-note}
**Proposed chapter scope:** Getting data from web APIs with `httr2`. JSON responses motivate a proper explanation of lists and nested data, and turning them into data frames (`unnest_wider`, `hoist`). Pagination gives a natural use for `while`; error handling and rate limits give natural uses for `if` and `possibly`, building on the functions and `map` from @sec-scraping.

Use APIs that send CORS headers so they work in webR (e.g. the Wikipedia API with `origin=*`), or fall back to recorded responses as in @sec-llm.
:::
